notes: Most code-style defects in this chunk were already in the known ledger and were suppressed: the Makefile help label, the bootstrap/nightly duplication, sync_skills jq duplication, the squash git-log duplication, the hook tokenizer copy, stale header/comment items, and the routines/README and skills/README drift. I also dropped two drafted claims on re-check. (a) Bare plan-ID comment references such as '(change plan C3/C4)' and '(plan D7)' follow an established repo convention: more than 100 '(Dn)'/'(plan Dn)' comments exist at base. (b) The claim-count mismatch in the docs/acdsl-go-tools.md:3 header has a plausible reading (4 fully refuted plus R5 partially refuted). Cross-chunk suspicion for the station, not a code-style claim: cmd/hooks/skill-invoke-gate.sh:52 tells a gated agent to invoke the skill '(bare, no args)', while railroad-review SKILL CTX-002a requires args='lane:<direction>' for the per-direction context slice. An agent that follows the deny text gets the unmapped full declaration. The copy deployed in this session's ~/.claude/hooks already lacks that phrase. Also outside this lens: the skill-eval QUALITY_CONTEXT/brief paths under plans/archived/ are already a known entry.

findings.claim: The Windows prerequisites table lists the from-source path's winget-installed prerequisites as 'Git for Windows, Go, jq', but this change makes install.ps1 also detect shellcheck and add koalaman.shellcheck to the winget consent list. The README's hand-kept copy of the prerequisite list now disagrees with the script it documents.
findings.failure_scenario: A Windows operator without shellcheck reads README.md:76, prepares Git/Go/jq, runs install.bat, and is then prompted to install an unlisted fourth package (koalaman.shellcheck); declining throws 'prerequisites missing; aborting'.
findings.fix: README.md:76 — change the Needs cell to 'Git for Windows, Go, jq, shellcheck (installed via winget after a consent prompt)'.
findings.evidence: Re-read README.md:71-78 at 1f725ce (table row 76 unchanged by this diff) and install.ps1:15-32 (line 20, added in this diff, appends koalaman.shellcheck to $missing; lines 25-27 prompt and throw on decline). The README row was not touched in the same change, so the documented list is short by one entry. Known-ledger check: the open install.ps1 finding concerns shellcheck being a hard rather than warn-only prerequisite, not the README table, so this claim is distinct. Rechecked macOS side: README.md:50 does not enumerate install.sh dependencies, so no parallel drift there.
